The decision relied only on market data (price, spread, volume) — no reported financial statement figures (revenue, EPS, etc.) were available in the summary, so none were relied upon. The account now holds 100 MSFT and 44 AAPL with roughly $40.2k in cash, leaving ample headroom under today's $20,000 total limit; do note the MSFT position for context if you want a second trade today.
